title: File:Place MostHighestofThailand.jpg
claims: The image shows the summit sign on Doi Inthanon: a dark wooden board lettered in Thai with 'สูงสุดแดนสยาม', in English with 'THE HIGHEST SPOT IN THAILAND' and with smaller elevation text, above stone steps and visitors, surrounded by mountain forest.
The Commons file describes the subject as the highest point of Siam in Doi Inthanon National Park; it is a summit marker photograph, not a 2026 course, finish arch or timing-point photograph.

The author is Thanyakij at Thai Wikipedia; the file is public domain; the original upload date is 2007-03-11; the original is 1,024 x 768 pixels and 273,506 bytes; it was transferred to Commons on 2007-04-22.
The route page uses a 960 x 720 copy of 237,681 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits the author, public-domain status and source.
